limitations: Range, visibility, cover, legal target, prerequisites and reaction triggers still require DM confirmation.
Interception, Deflect Attacks, redirected damage, Slow Fall and Crusher pushes use manual reaction/damage review. They are labeled reference-only.
Piercer’s structured reroll currently selects a digital weapon die. Physical rerolls and Sneak Attack die rerolls need a manual ruling.
Mobility effects and Guiding Bolt/Ray of Frost follow-ups use visible reminders; movement and consumption of advantage are manual.
Ammunition uses the tracked Arrows resource. Equipment rows are not independently spent a second time.
No new physical phone or TV rehearsal and no provider request. Live phone service was not restarted.
